feat(machines): Tormach 24R and xsTECH Pro router machine files

Two inch machine files from Tormach's published documents: the 24R
(UM10564 0826A § 2.2) and the xsTECH Pro (spec sheet 2026 + CE manual
UM10859 § 2, the smaller Y/Z travel where they disagree). Registered in
posting::MACHINES; both are mills by kind and post through the PathPilot
post. The 24R's 10000 rpm spindle floor refuses mill-speed jobs; the
xsTECH Pro states no feed and no spindle minimum (none documented) and
its standard 4-station ATC. New suite tormach_routers pins the figures,
the PathPilot post and the 24R refusal.

Refs #620

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL

feat(machines): the plain Tormach xsTECH Router

Inch machine file for the original xsTECH Router, from Tormach's public
pages (no manual exists): spec sheet 02/25, product and package pages,
and the knowledge base. Travel 8.6 x 6.3 x 2.4 in; spindle 5000-15000
rpm at 0.08 kW - the narrowest window and smallest motor the sources
state, as the spindle changed between builds; 120 IPM on every axis;
manual ER11 collet (no ATC stated); no rigid tapping, no coolant; safe
retract Z0. Registered in posting::MACHINES as a mill, so it posts
through the PathPilot post. tormach_routers pins its figures, the post
(now at S12000, inside every router's window) and the spindle window
refusals.

Fixes #620
